synthesis.trait: Freezes and reacts with visible fear when summoned by an authority figure
Stalls/delays complying, quietly evading rather than confronting directly
Flees physically to avoid capture when directly confronted
Cooperates with basic, low-risk factual answers once caught and questioned
Denies knowledge or wrongdoing to protect himself under threat

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Stalls/delays complying, quietly evading rather than confronting directly
turning_points.what_changes: Passive stalling (slowly removing gear before responding) escalates into an actual physical escape attempt, running and vaulting a fence into a trailer lot -- a far greater risk than mere delay.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Flees physically to avoid capture when directly confronted
turning_points.what_changes: The same unbroken chase continues, now with Ricardo leaping between parked trailers as John closes in, extending the flight sequence at heightened physical risk.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Flees physically to avoid capture when directly confronted
turning_points.what_changes: The chase sequence concludes here in one continuous motion -- Ricardo's leap is followed immediately by John tackling him to the ground, exposing that his capacity to evade has a limit and he can be physically overtaken.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Freezes and reacts with visible fear when summoned by an authority figure
turning_points.what_changes: His fear response, first triggered by a routine PA summons, now escalates to visible terror under the explicit threat of an ICE call -- a categorically higher personal stake than the earlier workplace summons.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Denies knowledge or wrongdoing to protect himself under threat
turning_points.what_changes: After flatly denying any knowledge ('I know nothing... I love America'), he now answers 'Yes' and begins to admit involvement once John intensifies the threat -- his denial cracks under greater pressure than it had faced before, revealing the limit of that self-protective lie.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Denies knowledge or wrongdoing to protect himself under threat
turning_points.what_changes: Directly continuing the admission just extracted, he now names specific coworkers (Alberto, Raymond), extending the same unbroken confession further into concrete, incriminating detail.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Denies knowledge or wrongdoing to protect himself under threat
turning_points.what_changes: The same unbroken disclosure continues as he volunteers further specifics about Raymond's firing, without prompting resistance or reversion to denial.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Denies knowledge or wrongdoing to protect himself under threat
turning_points.what_changes: Cooperation continues uninterrupted as he adds personal detail -- the bar, the friendship with Alberto -- deepening the same ongoing disclosure rather than starting a new one.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Flees physically to avoid capture when directly confronted
turning_points.what_changes: Ricardo's own line -- 'I think ICE get him. That's why I run from you.' -- directly and concretely answers the earlier unexplained flight through the trailer lot, supplying in his own words the motive the story had withheld until now.
